blocks.text: Setting up Notion for customer success associates on Mac

The Notion desktop app for Mac is the best way to keep your work separate from your browser. Download the official app from the Notion website. Ensure you are running macOS 13 or later. Once installed, log in with your company credentials. Use the ⌘ + P command to open the search bar. This is your most important shortcut. You can find any page or database in seconds. Never waste time clicking through the sidebar.

Customer success relies on good data hygiene. Create a master database for your accounts. Use properties to track status, renewal dates, and priority levels. Create a template for each new account. This ensures you always capture the same information during onboarding. Use the /template command inside a database to set this up. You can include sections for contact info, recent activity, and meeting notes.
Practical Notion tips for daily work

items: Use callouts for important notes or warnings about an account.
Use toggles to hide long meeting notes and keep pages clean.
Filter your databases by status to see only active accounts.
Add a table of contents to long playbook pages for easy navigation.
Use ⌘ + Shift + L to lock a page and prevent accidental edits.

blocks.text: Lazur helps you stay in your flow while you work in Notion. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about a specific setting on your screen. If you cannot find a button, ask Lazur to point it out. Hold fn to dictate your meeting notes directly into a Notion page. This saves you from typing everything manually. Your notes will be clean and formatted.

You spend a lot of time documenting calls. Use a standardized note-taking structure in Notion. Create a page for every meeting. Add a date property and a relation to your account database. This connects your notes to the right client. When you finish a call, dictate your summary using Lazur. This ensures your CRM data is accurate and up to date.

items: Avoid creating too many sub-pages that are hard to find later.
Do not ignore database properties; they make filtering possible.
Do not leave old pages in your workspace; archive them in a dedicated folder.
Do not rely solely on memory; use the search function regularly.
Do not forget to sync your calendar with your Notion tasks.

blocks.text: Advanced Notion features for success teams

Use formula properties to calculate renewal dates automatically. This helps you track upcoming tasks without manual checks. Create a dashboard page that shows your priority tasks for the week. Use linked database views to pull in data from different sources. This gives you a single view of your customer health. Keep your workspace simple to ensure your team follows the same process.

faq.question: How do I search my Notion workspace on Mac?
faq.answer: Press ⌘ + P to open the command search bar. Type your query to find any page, database, or block.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur to write notes in Notion?
faq.answer: Yes. Hold the fn key to dictate text directly into any Notion field. Lazur will format your speech into clean text.

faq.question: What is the best way to track customer renewals?
faq.answer: Create a database with a date property for renewal dates. Use a calendar view to visualize your upcoming renewals.

faq.question: How do I keep my Notion workspace organized?
faq.answer: Use database templates for consistency, archive old pages, and use filters to hide unnecessary information.

faq.question: Does Lazur work inside the Notion desktop app?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur works in any app on your Mac, including the Notion desktop app.
